Create an opaque imaging feature view for dsFlower

Source: R/catalog.R
ds.imaging.feature_view.Rd

Assigns a complete radiomics/feature asset behind a session-bound capability. Unlike ds.imaging.load_asset(), this never places a data.frame in the workspace: dsFlower receives the patient mapping only through dsImaging's trusted same-session resolver.

Usage

ds.imaging.feature_view(
  conns,
  asset_id,
  symbol = "imaging_features",
  columns = NULL,
  handle = "img"
)

Arguments

conns

DSI connections object.

asset_id

Character asset id/alias used on every server, a named list with one id per server, or a workflow-status result.

symbol

Character; target feature-view symbol.

columns

Optional public feature-column selection.

handle

Character; initialized imaging handle.

Value

Invisibly TRUE.
